Talk to our teamAbout Orvix
ZD
01 · Vice President

Ziad Darras

Vision, strategy, governance and major customer relationships.

Ziad Darras is a technology executive with more than 25 years of experience in the ICT sector. His focus is strategic growth, business development, technology commercialization and market expansion across the MENA region. As Founder and CEO, he leads Orvix’s strategic partnerships and go-to-market work across enterprise, government and telecommunications.

He holds a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration and pairs deep technology-sector experience with commercial judgment. His areas of focus are cybersecurity, AI-driven networking, digital infrastructure and emerging technologies.

He builds partner ecosystems and turns new technologies into commercially sound businesses that can scale.

DS
02 · Chief Technology Officer

Daryl Simpson

Technology strategy, architecture, technical delivery and innovation.

Daryl Simpson has spent more than two decades in enterprise technology at Cisco, Verizon, KPMG and World Wide Technology. He has advised Global 100 firms on application development, infrastructure and artificial intelligence, and holds a range of industry certifications. His work spans financial services, insurance, healthcare and telecommunications, sectors where regulation, scale and risk meet.

As Chief Technology Officer at Orvix, he leads technology and solutions strategy across the GCC, wider MENA and the United States. His focus is AI governance for regulated organizations, helping them move AI from pilot to production while keeping it secure and auditable. He describes himself as a lifelong student of what comes next.

AM
03 · Chief Marketing Officer

A. M.

Brand, market positioning, demand generation and communications.

Our Chief Marketing Officer owns the brand, its positioning in the GCC and US markets, demand generation and communications, including the Perspectives research programme and its newsletter.

She works alongside the engineering and assurance teams so that what Orvix publishes is what Orvix does: positioning built on delivered work, in language a board can read.

MJ
04 · Chief Financial Officer

Marwan Jaffal

Commercial discipline, finance, operating rhythm and scalable execution.

Marwan Jaffal has eight years of experience in accounting and finance, working where financial discipline meets operational change.

At Orvix he is building toward a fully automated finance function. Financial technology, AI and digital workflows replace manual entry, which reduces error and turns accounting into a real-time input to decisions.

Alongside his role at Orvix he owns a private business. He sees automation as the basis for growing the company with discipline.
